name: Rover: Intelligence, democratized.
tagline: A voice and messaging assistant for visually impaired users that texts, calls businesses and automates the web.
problem: Accessibility tools for visually impaired people are split across platforms.
solution: Integrates iMessage, two voice agents for incoming and outgoing calls, web automation and retrieval in one assistant.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask it to call a business and book something.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won the prize for best Devpost write-up.

lessons: A thorough write-up is itself a prize category.
